scope: Reviewed resume fact wording must retain recognizable credential, issuer, acronym, date, and number tokens from the selected approved source fact.
behavior: Reviewed wording that drops Cisco or CCNA, CompTIA or Security+, or a certification-context issuer/credential name is rejected with RESUME_REPHRASE_FACTS_CHANGED.
Rewording remains user-authored and explicitly reviewed; no paraphrase provider or generated wording was added.
Dates and numbers remain exact, current source-fact hashes continue to bind immutable rewrite history, and a failed preparation creates no tailored document version.
Existing UI review state resets after wording edits; browser coverage verifies the user sees the backend rejection through the existing job preparation flow.

verification.details: 20 tests passed, including durable no-new-version behavior and local Chromium UI recovery. The browser test injects a terminal worker failure payload matching the integration contract; it does not claim to execute the worker in-browser.
TypeScript check and Vite production build passed using the existing local dependency cache; no web application source was changed.

limitations: Credential/issuer recognition is intentionally conservative: acronym and symbol-bearing names, internally capitalized names, and proper-case names in certification-bearing facts are protected. Unusual issuer/name casing outside these recognizable forms may need additional reviewed examples.
The umbrella requirement remains OPEN/PARTIAL; this does not prove semantic equivalence, add automatic rewrite, or complete tailoring and ATS workflows.
PostgreSQL and live employer/ATS behavior, hosted checks/review, and whole-product release eligibility were NOT_RUN. External application submission remains OFF.
